name: render
description: Render slides or pages to PNG to look at them, at most 4 per call. Images cost tokens; the result states how many.

slides.description: Decks: slide numbers from 1, or ids (s:256, $ref); layouts L2, masters M0.

sheet.description: Up to 30 in one labelled image; {} for defaults.

range.description: Documents: blocks, spans p:A..t:B or sections s:2; their facts, pages.

fast.description: Quicker image while building: same layout, approximate pixels; the result says so. Default false.
